fullClause: Reports shall enforce audience-specific aggregation and small-cell controls. Patient-level drilldown and exports shall require an approved purpose and separate access.
Acceptance: Combining filters cannot reveal a suppressed small group or bypass person-level access restrictions.

Exports shall identify report definition, period, filters, generation time and user, with protected access and expiry where appropriate. Official reporting shall pass a review and submission state distinct from a draft export.
Acceptance: An exported report reconciles to the displayed governed measure and cannot be downloaded by an unauthorised role.
